contributions.statement: Treat any embedding index of code that agents retrieve from as poisonable: behaviour- and AST-preserving identifier renaming makes irrelevant snippets outrank relevant code in commercial code embedders and in LLM repository retrieval, so index only reviewed branches and record retrieved-snippet provenance.
contributions.evidence: Table 1 transfer from small surrogates to Nomic/Voyage-code-3 with correlated ΔSim; Table 5 RepoQA: GPT-5.4-mini Python 96 -> 81, C++ 92 -> 70, similar drops incl. Java with two adversarial candidates; shared-corpus setting (Table 4) much milder (MRR -12 to -38). The provenance/reviewed-branch mitigation is not tested; the only defense studied is robust finetuning.
relative_to: adversarial identifier-renaming attacks on code models

reason: Shows the poisoning transfers to closed commercial embedders and LLM retrieval including Java; a real constraint for any RAG layer, though the headline 77% drop is the most favourable threat model.
